visual_system_craft.suggestion: 1) Rebuild the skill tree on a strict grid system. Align all nodes to a consistent column and row structure to create a clear, readable matrix. 2) Standardize the connecting lines. Use a consistent line style (e.g., thin, glowing gold) and ensure they clearly connect the centers of nodes, forming a logical path. 3) Balance the composition. Distribute the nodes more evenly across the canvas to avoid the empty space on the right. 4) Unify the node design. Ensure all nodes, including locked ones, share the same base geometry and visual language, with state (locked, available, active) indicated by color or icon overlay rather than a completely different design. 5) Establish a semantic color system for the attribute bars. Use a consistent color palette that reflects the RPG theme (e.g., gold for primary stats, muted tones for secondary) to reduce visual noise. 6) Refine the sidebar typography. Apply a consistent type scale and weight to all labels and values to improve readability and polish.
